messages:
pete-docs: Quick sync: I'm updating the Dedicated provisioning guide to include a short 'capacity troubleshooting' section. Customers hit weird errors when reserved pools are misconfigured. I have a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1316
sara-eng: Can you add the exact api error strings? Those help support. I can paste them.
pete-docs: yes plz. Also want to add a sample k8s annotation to force tenant affinity in private deployments.
ollie-ux: tiny UX note: the console wording 'reserve capacity' confused one beta tester; suggest 'commit capacity' in copy. Might be out of scope but leaving note.
eng-runtime-bot: recommended error mappings:
- 409: reserved_pool_conflict 
- 422: invalid_isolation_label 
- 503: capacity_unavailable_preemption_possible
eng-runtime-bot: k8s annotation example:
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    redwood.ai/tenant-affinity: "tenant-42"
```
sara-eng: thanks. Also add a troubleshooting step to check reserved pool namespace and RBAC perms. We saw a tenant fail because the service account lacked access.
pete-docs: added RBAC checklist and the error strings to the draft. I'll also add the console copy suggestion as a footnote for PM review.
devx-bot: preview for PR 1316: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1316 :rocket:
pete-docs: will wait for eng-runtime signoff on error strings then merge.
